        📥 How to Download SSC CPO SI 2024 Final Result with Marks

        
            Visit the official website at https://ssc.gov.in.
            Click on the “SSC CPO SI 2024 Revised Final Result” link under the latest notifications.
            Download the revised final result PDF containing the merit list of selected candidates (roll numbers).
            Search for your roll number in the PDF to check your selection status.
            Save and print the revised final result PDF for future reference.
        

        Note: The revised final result incorporates changes from the previous merit list. Verify all details carefully. Contact SSC support via https://ssc.gov.in for any issues.
